metadata.name: EEG filter demo
metadata.description: Experimental BIDS import, signal inspection, and MNE band-pass with optional notch filtering and before/after previews.

nodes.label: BIDS EEG
nodes.description: Use a discovered project-local BIDS EEG dataset as a workflow input.

parameters.label: Dataset root
parameters.description: Project-relative path to a discovered BIDS EEG dataset.

nodes.label: Inspect Signal
nodes.description: Read measured signal and acquisition properties without transforming the recording or generating previews.

parameters.label: Recording path
parameters.description: Path to one discovered recording, relative to its dataset root.

nodes.label: Band-pass Filter
nodes.description: Apply an MNE FIR band-pass and optional notch filter to EEG channels, with a bounded before/after preview and provenance.

parameters.label: Low cutoff (Hz)
parameters.description: High-pass cutoff in Hz; must be lower than the high cutoff.

parameters.label: High cutoff (Hz)
parameters.description: Low-pass cutoff in Hz; must be below the recording's Nyquist frequency.

parameters.label: Notch frequencies (Hz)
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated notch centers in Hz; leave blank to disable. Each center must fall within the pass band and below Nyquist.

parameters.label: Notch width (Hz)
parameters.description: Width passed to MNE's FIR notch filter, in Hz.
